row.notes: New row. TrustRadius (the B2B review site; the product IT would renew is the vendor portal) has been folded into HG Insights as 'HG Customer Voice'; solutions.trustradius.com/pricing/ redirects to HG Insights' Customer Voice pricing page, which offers a free profile and otherwise contact-sales packages with no prices. No SSO, SAML, SCIM or user API documentation exists on solutions.trustradius.com, the HG Insights knowledge base (support.hginsights.com) or the old TrustRadius help centre (trustradius.zendesk.com is closed). Not in the Okta OIN, Entra gallery or JumpCloud guide list. Unknown rather than none because hginsights.com blocks plain requests (403) and its sitemap could not be read, so the HG platform's admin/security pages were not fully searched. Consider renaming or merging under HG Insights at merge time.
